Folks — forwarding initial findings and a temporary mitigation. Attaching the pulled scheduler logs.

Findings:
- Confirmed overlapping maintenance window (node pool drain) concurrently with autoscaler rebalance leading to cache thrash.
- One replica failed to rejoin for ~18 minutes due to an image-pull timeout (network flakiness).

Temporary mitigation applied:
- Paused automatic maintenance on the FB cluster until we complete a hardened drain plan.
- Increased warmup concurrency for prefix cache on startup to prevent repeated cold-start timeouts.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Full RCA write-up (Alex) — target 48 hours
- Hardened maintenance playbook and scheduler constraints (Rishi) — target 72 hours
- SLA credit proposal (Marissa) — will share in the exec summary prior to Thursday's MAP call

Attachments: SLA-incident-logs.zip (log bundle)

Subject: Executive summary — SLA incident, mitigation, action items, and proposed credit bands

Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for raising this. Below is a concise executive summary for the MAP record and for your exec sponsor:

Summary of incident:
- Impact window: 2026-02-08T22:30:00Z to 2026-02-09T01:10:00Z; intermittent 504s affecting ~25% of token-generation requests.
- Cause: maintenance scheduling overlap + transient image-pull failures that prevented a replica from rejoining.

What we did (short-term):
- Paused scheduled maintenance on the FB cluster (Alex) — immediate mitigation in place.
- Increased prefix-cache warmup concurrency (Rishi) — reduced cold-start timeouts for restarted replicas.
- Pulled and shared scheduler logs (Alex) for transparency.

Owners & milestones:
- Alex Reed (CloudOps): RCA write-up — due 2026-02-14T16:45:00-08:00
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood SRE): Hardened maintenance playbook & scheduler constraints — due 2026-02-16T17:00:00-08:00
- Marissa Cole (Redwood AM): SLA credit proposal + exec summary for Friday MAP call — due 2026-02-14T12:00:00-08:00

Proposed SLA credit bands (for discussion):
- Tier A (full pilot impact, >2h system-wide interruption): 8–12% of monthly committed spend
- Tier B (partial impact, ~1–3h, localized to pilot workloads): 4–8%
- Tier C (minor disruption, <1h or <10% of traffic): 1–3%

Requested approvals / next steps:
- Elena: confirm you’re comfortable with the proposed credit band approach for negotiation (Tier B expected based on current estimates).
- FinBridge & Redwood leadership: review and sign off on final credit number post-RCA.
- MAP call Thursday: finalize remediation timeline and lock acceptance gate date 2026-02-24.

I will attach the formal credit proposal and include the finalized action-item roster prior to the call.

Thanks — Marissa
